usability.consent: The participant signed the consent form and agrees to this session being recorded on this device.
usability.delete.confirm: Delete this session from this device? Save the file first if you still need it.
usability.done: Session ended. Save the file, then delete the data from this device.
usability.recording: Recording on this device only · {n} events · no note text
usability.retention: Delete the file too once the round's analysis is written (consent form, section 5). Data left on this device is deleted after 30 days.
usability.setup.intro: For the moderator. Enter the participant's code (P1…P8, never a name). Recording starts only after the participant has signed the consent form and you tick the box.
usability.sus.intro: Ask the participant to rate each statement about the whole session.
usability.sus.save: Save the answers and end the session
usability.title: Usability study
